:::{#def-mode}
#### Mode of a density or mass function

Let $f$ be a [density](#def-pdf) or [mass function](#def-pmf) with domain $A$.
A **mode** of $f$ is an element of the [argmax](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra.html#def-argmax) of $f$ over $A$:

$$x^* \in \argmax_{x \in A} f(x).$$

:::
